Reviewed workflow_run boundary: read-only authorization binds protected controller SHA, successful same-repository main producer, exact run/attempt and sealed artifacts without producer execution. Default-off main-only writers are isolated: production Release Please repeats API authorization for the pinned official action; image-publish uses only its package-write job token for fixed GHCR copies, exact readback and guarded nightly ancestry under the queue. Separate job tokens retain exact PR origins with pull-requests write and release origin/producer-selection receipts with contents write; API-bound successful protected jobs, immutable asset bytes and fully revalidated retry endorsements establish provenance before future release writes. No project execution or release-version registry publication is enabled by these receipts. The independent default-off Pages job uses only pages, id-token and deployments write under the main-only github-pages environment: it reauthorizes the sealed single-TAR preparation, records a protected-job-bound intent before the Pages API call, authenticates the newest durable intent as a source frontier including failed attempts, detects insertions after its recorded history boundary, and checks forward-only ancestry, and verifies service success plus credential-free exact index readback. A bounded reviewed historical bootstrap binds the retired Docs deployment and current index for the first cutover. The independent default-off package writer uses only its package-write job token under the main-only package-publish environment. Read-only preparation revalidates exact durable release origins and selected producers, sealed original tarballs and current dependency scans; all internal dependencies require authorized versions and exact registry byte readback before any upload. The writer reauthorizes the successful sealed preparation and publishes immutable versions with content-derived staging tags only. A separate contents-write finalizer retains exact tarball and successful writer identities on the corresponding Release; incomplete finalizer retries require original writer evidence and a new successful endorsement without changing the pinned producer. Completed dependency receipts and exact registry bytes remain usable after producer artifact expiry. Image release matrix members bind exact positive release IDs in protected job names and sealed artifact identities. They reauthorize durable origins and pinned successful producers, freshly scan every catalog platform, and copy immutable full-SHA and exact version indexes with unchanged child configuration and layer readback. A separate per-release contents-write finalizer retains image digests and successful writer provenance with immutable retry endorsements. Independent alias preparation authenticates durable immutable receipts and exact registry bytes, with fresh current-policy scans for every changing target. Isolated package-write jobs promote only fixed stable aliases after exact observed-state checks, component version ordering and main ancestry; unknown or incomparable history fails closed. Every component image is verified before alias mutation. Prereleases remain immutable-only. Separate contents-write jobs append exact successful writer observations to Releases; those observations do not replace immutable receipt authority. The shared queue serializes these workflows without claiming registry compare-and-swap against external writers. Trigger or privilege changes require renewed review. Renewed review covers an explicit isolated main-dispatch recovery recorder: it reauthenticates completed credential-free full validation and the sealed request and registration, preserves original release origin and selection references, and appends a producer-named immutable receipt or fully revalidated retry endorsement. Recording excludes ordinary publication authorization and all dependent Release Please, registry, Pages and alias jobs. The recorder has no production environment, production secrets, package-write permission or application execution; recording does not authorize publication. Renewed review covers explicit publication from a successfully recorded recovery: the manual selector reauthenticates its exact release and recovery receipt while preserving original origin and producer selection. Isolated release package, release image and alias jobs repeat authorization and fresh byte and policy checks; immutable conflicts still fail. Either recovery input excludes main/nightly image publication, Pages and Release Please. Read-only authorization gains only pull-request read permission for origin verification.
